messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity -> org=BrightLoop. Sustained QPS spike detected, error_rate rising above threshold, multiple 429s. Escalate to oncall.

mike_oncall: Got the page, oncall here. Investigating, joining quick bridge.

ryan_infra: I can see the spike in metrics: org=brightloop, recent qps ~2200 (baseline 900), 429s ~11%, p50 latency ~480ms. Prefix cache hit drops.

aj_eng: Thanks. Quick question — is this traffic uniform or bursty? Any change in model selection?

ryan_infra: Looks sustained over last 8m, not a single burst. Top routes: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Embeddings are heavy — token usage up 3x.

sara_prod: Customer-facing: BrightLoop said they reran batch jobs accidentally. They're trying to throttle on their side but need immediate relief.

ops_lead: Two mitigation options: 1) temporary org-level RL bump, 2) soft-block embeddings for BrightLoop, 3) route to lower-cost quantized model. Which is fastest?

aj_eng: Fastest is an org RL bump for 30m with a rollback. Command ready: 
```
# internal admin API
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/orgs/brightloop/ratelimit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{"qps":1800, "duration":"30m", "reason":"emergency spike - agreed by oncall"}'
```
That will reduce 429s immediately. Disabling embeddings is slightly slower (policy churn).

mike_oncall: I authorize the temporary bump. Apply now and watch.

ryan_infra: Applying via infractl: 
```
infractl org ratelimit set --org brightloop --qps 1800 --ttl 30m --note "emergency spike - oncall mike"
```

infractl: org=brightloop ratelimit updated -> qps=1800 ttl=30m (id=rl-8a3f)

ryan_infra: Monitoring... 2m after change: qps dropped to ~1700, 429s down to 2.5%, p50 latency -> 220ms. Looks effective.

ops_lead: Good. @liz_cs please notify BrightLoop account that we've applied a temporary uplift and request confirmation they will throttle/retry on their side. Also ask for ETA to stop job.

liz_cs: Reached out via email & pinged their engineering Slack. They acknowledged and will stop the job in ~18m. Thanks for the quick uplift.

aj_eng: Quick note: we'll add a short-lived route policy to avoid feature-heavy routes hitting the platform as much: temporarily bump priority for small-chat routes and deprioritize embeddings for 20m if needed.

sara_prod: Logging: created incident ticket INC-2026-342 for postmortem. Tagging BrightLoop, cost impact, mitigation steps.

mike_oncall: Handing off monitoring to night shift once stable. If 429s climb again, escalate to dedicated mitigation (disable embeddings for org) and notify legal/enterprise.

ops_lead: We'll do a cost estimate after the incident. Reminder to run root-cause: why batch job executed and why rate-limits didn't auto-throttle earlier.

ryan_infra: Captured debug traces and API logs. I exported the request histogram and KV cache heatmap to the incident ticket.

incident-bot: NOTE: temporary ratelimit rl-8a3f will expire at 1789996121 (~30m).

mike_oncall: Thanks all. Standby for updates. :thumbsup:
